sentences.en: For these patients, surgical treatment is far from being satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 对于这些病人来说，手术治疗远不能令人满意。

sentences.en: I remonstrated with him about his treatment of his children.
sentences.zh: 我曾向他抗议他对孩子的对待方式。

sentences.en: Women have been resigned to unjust treatment for too long.
sentences.zh: 女性太久以来一直忍受着不公正的待遇。
